signature.name: VTask.IsMinBadSeq
signature.type: {α : Type u_2} -> (r : α → α → Prop) -> (rk : α → ℕ) -> (s : Set α) -> (n : ℕ) -> (f : ℕ → α) -> Prop

conventions.statement: If no bad sequence agrees with `f` on the first `n` terms and has smaller rank at position `n`, the predicate holds vacuously regardless of whether `f` is itself bad.
conventions.note: The definition's consequent is negation of IsBadSeq, so absence of qualifying competitors makes it trivially true.

conventions.statement: If `rk` is identically `0`, then `VTask.IsMinBadSeq r rk s n f` holds for all `r`, `s`, `n`, `f` because the strict inequality `rk (g n) < rk (f n)` can never be satisfied.
conventions.note: This is a degenerate case of the rank function making the minimality condition trivial.

facts.statement: ∀ (α : Type*) (r : α → α → Prop) (s : Set α) (n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → α), VTask.IsMinBadSeq r (fun _ => 0) s n f
